Rife Frequency Therapy

Therapy frequency-medicine rife spooky2 frequency-specific resonant-frequency

Evidence: opinion

Summary

Frequency therapy based on the work of Dr. Royal Raymond Rife - delivering specific audio and radio frequencies to target pathogens, support cellular function, and balance bio-resonant patterns. Modern implementations include Spooky2, F-100, and GB4000 devices.

Type: frequency

Benefits

  • Pathogen targeting via specific frequencies
  • Cellular energy enhancement
  • Bio-resonance balancing
  • Support for chronic conditions

Contraindications

  • Pacemaker or other implanted electronic devices
  • Epilepsy (seizure risk)
  • Severe mental health conditions (during acute phase)
  • Pregnancy

Session Duration: 30-60 minutes per session

Frequency Recommendation: 1-2 sessions per day for acute conditions; maintenance 3-4 times per week

Cost Range: $300-3000 for device; $25-75 per session with practitioner
